objective: Eliminate chat admission failures caused by untracked resident GPU models, then replace the rejected F5 candidate with a pinned VoxCPM2 CUDA candidate that clones the fixed Hina voice and remains intelligible on short and long Vietnamese replies.
non_goals: Do not run LLM, STT or TTS inference on CPU.
Do not expose arbitrary voice-upload or voice-cloning endpoints.
Do not claim that reference conditioning is model fine-tuning.
Do not claim ElevenLabs-equivalent quality before owner listening.
Do not leave multiple large GPU models resident after their conversational phase; brief overlap is allowed only when live admission still preserves the mandatory headroom.
contracts: The desktop launcher runs LLM, Faster-Whisper STT and TTS on GPU and fails loudly instead of falling back to CPU.
Only one large model workload may retain GPU memory between conversational phases; released scheduler leases must not leave untracked CUDA weights resident.
Every admission decision preserves at least 2048 MiB of reported local VRAM headroom.
VoxCPM2 uses only the fixed hash-bound owner-created synthetic Hina reference.
Long replies are split on Vietnamese sentence boundaries, each segment is validated, and a failed segment is retried or fails the whole synthesis instead of returning corrupt partial audio.
Complete text still passes pre-TTS moderation before provider inference.
allowed_dependencies: Pinned OpenBMB VoxCPM2 model and voxcpm inference package.
Existing PyTorch CUDA 12.8, torchaudio, soundfile, NumPy and Hugging Face Hub runtime.
Existing Ollama local model provider and Moonshine/Faster-Whisper speech dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Ollama receives keep_alive zero for chat streams so its GPU weights are released after the text phase.
GPU STT unloads after each request; TTS may retain one lower-priority scheduler lease between adjacent utterances and unloads deterministically on preemption or shutdown.
A chat followed by TTS no longer raises E_RESOURCE_CAPACITY on the owner's 16 GiB GPU while the 2048 MiB headroom rule remains enabled.
The selected model has explicit Vietnamese support, Apache-2.0 code and weight licensing, CUDA execution, 48 kHz output and zero-shot voice cloning.
Real short and long Vietnamese smoke WAVs are finite, non-silent, bounded, and pass automated round-trip intelligibility checks before the provider becomes the desktop default.
Fast speech, text-brain and desktop startup tests pass once without a deep repeat or soak gate.
